pages.text: On long winter nights, Grandpa Badger told stories by the stove.
Nono wanted to hear the whole story of the white snow fox.
He sat close to Grandpa. The story was so interesting!
Bells jingled outside. Nono flew to the window.
He watched the snow. Behind him, the story ended quietly.
The next day, the three played white fox. Gugu and Kiki acted out the ending.
Nono did not know what to do. He stood by himself.
That night, Grandpa patted Nono's place beside the stove.
Nono sat there. The bells jingled again, but this time he stayed.
He heard the whole ending. The next day, Nono was the first to tell it.
